name: Cable Crunch
summary: A weighted crunch with a high cable and rope, which lets you progressively load the abs.
setup: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel a short distance from the stack.
Hold the rope at both sides of your head, elbows pointing down.
Sit the hips back slightly and keep the hips still.
execution: Curl the spine by pulling the ribs toward the pelvis, bringing the elbows toward the thighs.
Hold briefly at the bottom with the abs fully contracted.
Return slowly to the upright position.
Keep the hips fixed and let the abs move the weight, not the arms.
mistakes: Pulling with the arms: keep the hands fixed beside the head and move through the trunk.
Moving the hips back and forth: keep them still and lighten the load.
Using too much weight: pick a load you can control for the full range.
Bending only at the hips: curl the spine, not just fold at the hips.
